auditType: Read-only static source audit; this new audit record is the only repository file written by this auditor.
scope: Selected source inventory and protected hosting bindings
Metro parking geometry and repeated-dwell work
Fourteen-scene configuration and active UI/reward guards

findings.state: Bounded parent fix inspected in current source; final release build pending.

before.problem: Previously emitted only git HEAD, which did not identify dirty or untracked source and asset changes.
Previous inline fingerprint covered public/city but omitted other shipped public assets, including character models, portraits and scenes.

fixInspected.result: Shared helper hashes all src, worker and public files plus executable build/configuration inputs; rejects linked entries in traversed directories.
Runtime build identity uses the shared helper.
build-info records sourceDirty and exact buildFingerprint alongside HEAD and campaign release name.
Existing fixture now checks model, portrait, scene, font and executable invalidation, stable identity after restoration, documentation exclusion and linked-public-input rejection.

findings.validationAttribution: Parent reported both new fingerprint regressions passing; auditor independently read the resulting helper, build code and tests. Auditor did not rerun the full suite.

findings.state: Bounded parent fix inspected in current source; native final-scene confirmation remains separate.

before.problem: Production metroRide moduleParams omitted immersiveHandoff, so ModuleBase.beginHandoff completed immediately without the physical carton pass.
The immediate-completion fallback applies when immersiveHandoff is absent.
Previous fixture hardcoded immersiveHandoff:true and therefore did not exercise the production omission.

fixInspected.result: Production Level10 now explicitly enables immersiveHandoff.
Existing metro fixture now supplies the real production moduleParams.

findings.validationAttribution: Parent reported18/18 metro regressions passing. Auditor independently read production configuration and revised fixture; no visual or likeness verdict is inferred.

otherStaticObservations.result: Full check:release already asserts exactly15 appearance decisions, the four distinct Level10 identities and actor-free Level4/12. No redundant completeness test proposed.
Warm jobs are deduplicated and limited to2; stale/cancelled work cannot install templates. Live instances and GPU borrows defer shared resource disposal until release.
Preparation changes on story selection/retry, completed scenery is capped at2 and removed after leaving its bounded area, and runtime disposal releases scenes and retained assets.
Parking follows the same finite10m platform chords as City surfaces, checks the whole car polygon and excludes guards, benches and passenger row. It does not add station geometry.
An unavailable station is cached during a dwell, preventing repeated polygon-placement work each frame; retry resumes at a different actual station.
Rendered/collision platform chord geometry matches the new source-based handoff helper.

Inspected14 ordered scenes with callMode NONE and empty scripts. Active names/destinations omit Mahesh/IMAX and Rajamouli/Film City. Two anonymous scenes intentionally have no named visible actor requirement.
Active carrier campaign bypasses legacy coin reward/save/order-offer paths and hides coin updates; no money reward is introduced by these scene changes.
QA/candidate review entry remains DEV-gated. Build imports through this guarded path can be tree-shaken; final built-output exclusion still requires release-build inspection.

remainingRequiredVerification: Finish exact final-metro independent registration and update final written status.
Run npm run check:release after final source integration; this auditor did not claim the complete gate passed.
Re-run final source inventory with --require-complete, copy only the selected source into the isolated checkout and preserve its own hosting binding.
Build from the final source snapshot and verify build-info identity plus DEV/candidate/raw-asset exclusion in the produced deployment artifact.
Keep manual pickup/travel/handoff and physical-device acceptance separate from static tests and assisted scene evidence.
conclusion: The two concrete omissions above received bounded parent fixes that this auditor read. No additional concrete unbounded frame-loop or actor/GPU lease leak was identified by this static review. This is not measured performance, full-campaign acceptance or deployment authorization.

packagingMigrationNote.finding: Source .gitignore is minimal, while the isolated checkout has additional credential/private-evidence safeguards. The source manifest currently selects .gitignore, so a naive overwrite would discard those destination safeguards.
packagingMigrationNote.requiredHandling: Preserve the isolated checkout .gitignore and merge unique needed source patterns without removing destination safeguards. Preserve the isolated .openai hosting binding separately as already required.
packagingMigrationNote.manifestDeviation: The .gitignore bytes may intentionally differ from the source inventory; record the preserved/merged destination file as an explicit packaging deviation and inspect its final diff.
packagingMigrationNote.verificationAttribution: Parent identified the migration detail; auditor independently read the isolated checkout .gitignore. Final copy/diff verification remains parent work.
